title: Jensen Huang Is Back. But Nvidia's Story Isn't Over #Shorts
description:
Jensen Huang returned as Nvidia CEO on 23 Nov 2026, but open questions remain: he is due to sit for an interview with three House committees next week, and California's attorney general says its probe continues. And even after Monday's ~31.5% jump to $165.05, the stock is still about 31% below its record close of $239.24 on 6 Oct. Would you buy here or wait? (Not financial advice.)
